title: Golden Grid Abstraction
description: An abstract painting featuring a luminous white and gold geometric grid structure composed of vertical bars, horizontal lines, circles, and interconnected loops. The central form floats against a soft, ethereal background of blended pastel brushstrokes with bursts of bright yellow light and scattered glowing particles.
prompt: abstract painting of a glowing geometric grid made of vertical white bars, horizontal lines, and interconnected golden circles and loops floating in the center. Soft pastel background with blended brushstrokes in yellow, white, and light blue, bright yellow light bursts and scattered glowing particles, ethereal and luminous atmosphere, painterly style with visible texture
